title: SanRoque — First Look
author: MrKnuckls
content:
SanRoque is a co-op open-world survival game built in Unreal Engine 5. This dev log will track progress from early prototype to full release.

Current features:
- Procedural terrain with instanced tree system
- Basic inventory with drag-and-drop (6×6 grid + hotbar)
- EasyRoads 3D road network
- Custom character movement and interaction

Next up: crafting system, building framework, and the first enemy AI.

title: Inventory System Complete
author: MrKnuckls
content: The inventory system is fully functional — drag items between slots, equip weapons/armor, use consumables. Built with Jinxish Drag&Drop for the clean dark-slate UI with gold borders.\n\nFixed a namespace collision (CS0118) between SanRoque.Inventory and the drag-drop library. Everything compiles clean now.

title: Knuckls OS Announced
author: MrKnuckls
content: Knuckls OS is in early design — a custom operating system built from scratch. No timeline yet, but the architecture planning phase has started. Will document the kernel design, boot process, and system calls here as development progresses.

title: Home Lab Expansion
author: MrKnuckls
content: Added Pterodactyl panel for all game servers behind a Cloudflare Tunnel. Five steam servers running: PalWorld, StarRupture, Arma Reforger, DayZ, and Hytale. Centralized management through the panel — all automated, all monitored.\n\nLocal network (10.15.34.188) hosts everything with public access tunneled through Cloudflare.
